class.name: NNBTBlackboardErase
class.brief_description: Action leaf that removes a key from the blackboard.
class.description: Erases [member key] from the tree's blackboard, returning [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] if the key existed and [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE] if it was absent. Use to clear temporary state (such as a consumed target) directly in the tree without writing a script.
